mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and bradycardia that may potentiate dronedarone's cardiac effects and increase arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate) closely before and after zoledronic acid infusion; assess heart rate and rhythm; consider baseline ECG and periodic monitoring during concurrent use.
